dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave spline fitting on the trailing edge, transitioning from a neutral curve at the apex to a deeper indentation near the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a wide pixel radius, lacking any acute apical sharpening.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 35-degree posterior rake relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.7 times the vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convex arc with a large radius fitting the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick rostrum protruding from the melon with a low length-to-width pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 145 degrees at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: White mottled patches and faint linear striations visible on the anterior portion of the tail fluke and lower lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform high-saturation cyan/teal coloration across the entire dermal surface.
